A New Life In The Sun

programme.title: The Irrational, Season: 1, Episode: 1
programme.desc: Professor of behavioral science Alec Mercer is called upon to investigate the murder of a fashion influencer whose boyfriend, a decorated soldier and senator's son, has confessed to the crime. Mercer suspects there is more to the story, however.

programme.title: Farscape, Season: 3, Episode: 15
programme.desc: Jack unlocks Crichton's wormhole knowledge so they can build a device to destroy a Scarran dreadnought.

programme.title: Psych, Season: 7, Episode: 5
programme.desc: Shawn and Gus attend a party hosted by an aging rockstar named Billy Lipps, a man the SBPD arrested years ago for a murder he doesn't remember committing.

programme.title: Relic Hunter, Season: 1, Episode: 7
programme.desc: Sydney, Nigel and Derek Lloyd go to the Peruvian jungle to look for the Paracelsus scrolls which contain the formula for turning lead into gold.

programme.title: Renegade, Season: 5, Episode: 18
programme.desc: A series of local murders and other strange occurrences are believed by the locals to have been caused by a vampire.

programme.title: Renegade, Season: 5, Episode: 19
programme.desc: Bobby is nominated for an award and must prepare an acceptance speech in this highlight reel episode that takes a look back at the best scenes from all five seasons of "Renegade."

programme.title: The Irrational, Season: 1, Episode: 2
programme.desc: Professor Mercer is approached by his old friend CJ, a prominent investigative journalist, who asks for his help after she is poisoned with rare and deadly nerve agent. With time running out, Mercer pieces together scant clues.

programme.title: Taste of Love, A
programme.desc: Struggling to find her culinary voice as a Network TV star, Taylor returns to her hometown to visit her parents. She must choose between her renewed relationship, saving her family restaurant, or her dream career as a worldwide known chef.

programme.title: A Deadly Deed
programme.desc: A widowed heiress and her daughter find themselves in grave danger when secrets about her late husband's family and new boyfriend come to light.

programme.title: Ruth and Alex
programme.desc: Hollywood heavyweights Morgan Freeman (Driving Miss Daisy) and Diane Keaton (Manhattan) unite to redefine the term ‘coming of age’ in this heart-warming story about life, love and real estate! When a couple opts to put their apartment on the market over one crazy weekend, they discover that finding a new place is not about winding down but starting a whole new adventure!

programme.title: Accidental Family
programme.desc: A shy lonely genealogist finally discovers the perfect family and the love of her life… they just don’t know it yet! They mistakenly think she’s a long lost relative, and unfortunately he is engaged to the wrong girl who just wants his family fortune. As sparks start to fly, she must warn him of his deceptive fiance and find a way to tell him the truth about herself.

programme.title: Kindergarten Teacher
programme.desc: A kindergarten teacher in New York becomes obsessed with one of her students who she believes is a child prodigy.

programme.title: The White King
programme.desc: Djata is a care-free 12-year-old growing up in a brutal dictatorship shut off from the outside world. When the government imprisons his father, Peter, and Djata and his mother Hannah are labeled traitors, the boy will not rest until he sees his father again.

programme.title: Trigger Point
programme.desc: One man, one grudge and a target on his back. Disgraced U.S Secret Agent Nicolas Shaw is pulled out of hiding one last time into a world of death and espionage. With his skills put to the test and a small window of time to save a former colleague, Nicolas resorts to desperate measures to complete one last mission. Barry Pepper (The Green Mile) takes the lead in this masterclass of action-suspense.

programme.title: Alien Intervention
programme.desc: An alien visitor entrusts a powerful device to a young girl before he disappears with government officials. When he comes back 25 years later to reclaim it so he can return to his home planet, he finds the woman struggling to keep her business and marriage alive. With his return, her purpose is redefined and she is finally able to find inner peace.

programme.title: Abduction
programme.desc: An FBI agent and a sheriff searching for a missing woman in North Dakota begin investigating her religious fanatic husband, only to uncover something far more sinister.

programme.title: Escape Plan 3
programme.desc: The final instalment of the unstoppable franchise sees legend Sylvester Stallone kick this explosive action into high gear. Security expert Ray Breslin is hired to rescue the kidnapped daughter of a Hong Kong tech mogul, but his girlfriend is also captured. Now he and his team - Trent DeRosa (Dave Bautista) and Hush (Curtis 50 Cent Jackson), must pull off a deadly rescue mission.

programme.title: A Reason To Live, A Reason To Die
programme.desc: Branded a coward for surrendering his New Mexico fort to the Confederates without firing a shot, a Union colonel leads a band of condemned prisoners on a suicide mission to recapture it.

programme.title: Breakout
programme.desc: Imprisonment in a foreign country... it may be a fate far worse than death. Jay Wagner (Robert Duvall) is framed for murder by his scheming grandfather (John Huston). Unjustly convicted, he faces 28 hard years of confinement in a crowded Mexican prision. Wagner's guilt ridden wife Ann (Jill Ireland), who unwittingly aided in framing him by confiding in the grandfather, turn to pilot Nick Colton (Charles Bronson) and his partner Hawk (Randy Quaid) to help Wagner escape. Only the most cunning and daring tactics can spring Wagner, so Colton must plan the impossible. BREAKOUT builds to an explosive climax when Colton launches an all-out desparate helicopter raid that will either rescue the prisoner or cost the lives of all involved.

programme.title: Puppet On A Chain
programme.desc: Following a triple professional hit a U.S. agent arrives in Amsterdam to investigate a heroin smuggling ring. He finds a city rife with drugs and a police force unable or unwilling to do much about it. With his incognito female fellow agent the American is soon stirring things up.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes: The Sign of Four
programme.desc: Hired by a young woman, Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson investigate the strange recent deaths of her missing father's friends from the army and the whereabouts of the Great Mogul, the second-largest diamond in the world.

programme.title: Miracle on Christmas Lake, A
programme.desc: After a teenage boy loses his best friend and his Dad both around Christmas he quits his favorite sport of hockey and turns from is friends. When an ice rink magically appears on the frozen lake near his home, he reminisces the good times.

programme.title: Christmas Eve
programme.desc: Hilarity, romance and festive spirit prevail, when six New Yorkers get trapped in an elevator on Christmas Eve! Forcing the likes of a heartless real estate tycoon (Patrick Stewart- X-Men), a crass HR manager (Max Casella- The Sopranos), his ex-employee (Jon Heder- Napoleon Dynamite) and a cynical doctor (Gary Cole- Pineapple Express) to reconsider the way they think about others.

programme.title: You Can't Fight Christmas
programme.desc: Interior designer Leslie Major loves all things Christmas. When she meets handsome Edmund James, she quickly learns he thinks the festivities are frivolous and superficial. Determined to change his mind, Leslie works her Christmas magic on him, and the unlikely couple fall in love along the way.

programme.title: Christmas Oranges
programme.desc: Rose, an orphan, teaches the meaning of hope to all those around her. Share a slice of Christmas sweetened with friendship in this poignant story based on a classic holiday tale.

programme.title: Psych, Season: 4, Episode: 5
programme.desc: After a police department baseball game, the whole gang heads to a bar to celebrate McNab’s (Sage Brocklebank) birthday. As the waiters bring out the cake, Shawn spots a hooded man by the register with a bulge in his jacket. He runs to warn Lassiter who pulls out his weapons just as the hooded man starts to fire. After a barrage of bullets, the man manages to escape. The cops call it as an attempted robbery but Shawn claims the man came there specifically to kill one of them. He believes he will try again, but suggests that if they can figure out which one of them was the target, it will give them a clue to the man’s identity.

programme.title: Psych, Season: 4, Episode: 6
programme.desc: Raj (Sendhil Ramamurthy) waits in an alley to meet his girlfriend Mina (Azita Ghanizada), a dancer in a local Bollywood production, who he has been secretly dating. She sneaks outside on a break from the show, but is nearly killed when a runaway truck narrowly misses her. A distraught Raj goes to the police station, where he confesses to not only hurting Mina, but all of the women he has loved, claiming he’s cursed! Shawn and Gus take the case, thinking it will be an easy one since there is no such thing as curses... Or is there?

programme.title: Psych, Season: 4, Episode: 7
programme.desc: Leonard "Diddle" Callahan (Demond Dann), a college friend of Gus is chased by armed assailants and when he reaches his apartment building, drops his bike and runs inside. Before the men break in and asphyxiate him Diddle pulls a digital camcorder from his backpack and is able to email out its contents. Shawn and Gus attend Diddle's funeral where Shawn discovers that Gus was in a singing group with Diddle and their other friends Tony (Jaleel White) and Joon (Kenan Thompson), but he has been estranged from them for years and refuses to say why. When Tony and Joon are able to speak to Shawn alone they tell him Diddle was way too careful on his bike to die in an accident. They believe he was murdered, and they hire Shawn to find out what happened.

programme.title: Psych, Season: 4, Episode: 2
programme.desc: Chief Vick calls Shawn and Gus to the forest to aid in the search for billionaire Warren Clayton’s downed plane. They arrive at the wreckage before the police and find Clayton inside, barely alive. He manages to cough out the word "Waterloo," and asks them to find out who killed him. Clayton's widow, Alice (Christine Baranski), says that’s the name of the 18th hole at the club where he wanted his ashes scattered. Alice invites them to dinner, where Shawn meets the housekeeper Rosa (Carmen Moore), and Clayton’s son Garvin (Ryan Kennedy). After making some visual connections Shawn quickly realizes that realizes that everyone in the Clayton household had a motive.

programme.title: Psych, Season: 4, Episode: 3
programme.desc: Lassiter enlists the services of Shawn and Gus to uncover the truth about the strange occurrences happening in Old Sonora, a former historic mining town turned Old West tourist attraction where Lassiter spent most of his weekends as a child. Shawn and Gus spend the night with Sheriff Hank (James Brolin) who tells them of the legend of the Ghost Rider, a spirit that supposedly haunts the town. When Hank leaves to check on some riled horses and doesn't return Shawn and Gus find him as well as the horses and two fence posts missing. They turn towards a sound of thunder to see a stampede of horses headed straight for them!

programme.title: Psych, Season: 4, Episode: 4
programme.desc: After Agatha (Melanie Bray), a student at a Catholic college, jumps off the roof of a building, Gus drags Shawn to the school to investigate as a favor to an old teacher, Father Westley (Ray Wise). Lassiter and Juliet are already there speaking with Westley and headmaster Father Bard (Tim Conlon), who explain that Agatha was a model student until three weeks ago when she suddenly started acting irrationally. Lassiter thinks it's murder, Shawn is leaning towards suicide, while Father Westley believes she was possessed. Despite being roundly dismissed, even by Father Bard, Westley is insistent and Gus agrees to take the case, over Shawn’s objections.

programme.title: The Shepherd (2008)
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme stars in this hard-hitting action thriller about a border patrol agent who attempts to take down a rogue American Special Forces unit that's smuggling Afghan heroin into the United States.

programme.title: 7 Seconds
programme.desc: Action star Wesley Snipes is a professional thief whose high-stakes caper goes murderously wrong is this explosive, brilliantly unpredictable crime thriller.

programme.title: The International
programme.desc: An Interpol agent (Owen) attempts to expose a high-profile financial institution's role in an international arms dealing ring.

programme.title: Trapped
programme.desc: The parents of an abducted daughter go to unprecedented lengths to get her back unharmed.

programme.title: Seems Like Old Times
programme.desc: In Neil Simon's SEEMS LIKE OLD TIMES, Chevy Chase is forced to abet some bank robbers, and soon the cops are after him. His ex-wife, Goldie Hawn, is a liberal lawyer married to the local district attorney. When Chase arrives at their home seeking shelter, she takes him in and their passions are rekindled.

programme.title: Made Of Honor
programme.desc: A guy in love with an engaged woman tries to win her over after she asks him to be her maid of honor.

programme.title: Maid In Manhattan
programme.desc: A woman (Lopez) takes a job as a chambermaid at a luxury hotel in New York. She meets and falls in love with a debonair heir to an America political dynasty (Fiennes), who mistakes her for a society woman. When her real identity is revealed, the truth sets in about the disparity of their lives.

programme.title: Daddy Day Camp
programme.desc: DADDY DAY CARE pals Charlie and Phil are back in this hilarious, all-new adventure: DADDY DAY CAMP! When the dads expand their childcare magic to Camp Driftwood - serving up sports, crafts and teaching the kids a thing or two about nature, they discover the camp has everything it needs except a plan to put the bullies of rival Camp Canola to shame. With some quick thinking, teamwork, a secret weapon and some off-the-wall crazy antics, the dads and kids unite to make sure DADDY DAY CAMP secures its rightful place in kid camp history!

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Things get complicated when the team gets called to a hijacked casino bus full of senior citizens.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: When Chris returns for a visit, his reunion takes a shocking turn when his son, Christian, is abducted.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Near the end of a shift, 15 Division busts a marijuana grow-op.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: When a pedophile is found beaten, Andy discovers Marlo has been conducting an off-hours “investigation."

programme.title: The Legend of Hercules
programme.desc: Banished by the king, Hercules harnesses his powers and gathers an army to fight his way back to his kingdom.

programme.title: Conan the Barbarian
programme.desc: The legendary Cimmerian warrior, Conan, fights an epic battle against hulking rivals, horrific monsters, and impossible odds, as he realizes he is the only one who can save the great nations of Hyboria from an encroaching reign of supernatural evil.

programme.title: Frankenstein Meets the Wolf Man
programme.desc: Bela Lugosi as Frankenstein's Monster and Lon Chaney Jr. as the cursed Wolf Man collide in one of the great classic horror films of the 1940s. Beginning as a moody chiller, director Roy William Neill sets the stage for an unforgettable clash. The resurrected Wolf Man, seeking a cure for his malady, enlists the aid of mad scientist Patric Knowles, who claims he will not only rid the Wolf Man of his nocturnal metamorphosis but will also revive the frozen body of Frankenstein's inhuman creation.

programme.title: Bride of Frankenstein
programme.desc: One of the most popular horror classics of all time and an acclaimed sequel to the original Frankenstein. The legendary Boris Karloff reprises his role as the screen's most understood monster who now longs for a mate of his own. Colin Clive is back as the overly ambitious Dr. Frankenstein, who creates the ill-faed bride (Elsa Lanchester).

programme.title: Fact Or Faked: Paranormal Files
programme.desc: In a chilling new episode, Bill, Chi-Lan and Larry travel to Victor, New York to investigate the haunted Valentown Museum.

programme.title: Brides of Dracula
programme.desc: Marianne (Yvonne Monlaur), a beautiful young French girl, is stranded en route to a teaching assignment in Eastern Europe. She is persuaded to spend the night at the nearly deserted castle of a mysterious Baroness (Martita Hunt). In the castle, Marianne accidentally discovers a man chained to the wall of his room. The Baroness only explains that he is her sick and feeble-minded son.

programme.title: Dr. Cyclops
programme.desc: Dr. Thorkel (Albert Dekker) has developed a process that will shrink human beings to doll size. Mining engineers Bill Stockton (Thomas Coley) and Steve Baker (Victor Kilian) and biologists Mary Mitchell (Janice Logan) and Dr. Bullfinch (Charles Halton) are his first victims. Initially benevolent, Thorkel shows his true colors by murdering Bullfinch in cold blood. Our protagonists must escape through a now-unfamiliar world lest they suffer the same fate. Dr.

programme.title: Crossing the Line
programme.desc: From the team behind Oscar winners La La Land and Call Me by Your Name. This modern Western showcases breathtaking performances by Tessa Thompson and Lily James, who portray sisters forced into a life of crime to save their family. Faced with betrayal and violence, they risk everything on a drug smuggling mission. A brutally fresh look at all of Americas ills. Winters Bone meets Frozen River.

programme.title: All Roads Lead To Rome
programme.desc: A timeless and moving romantic comedy. Uptight mother Maggie (Sarah Jessica Parker: Sex and the City) and her former Italian lover, Luca, go on a road trip across scenic Italy pursuing Maggie's rebellious teenage daughter (Rosie Day: Outlander) who tries desperately to return to New York. An unmissable, feel-good rom-com with a stellar cast. Not to be missed!

programme.title: Witch Hunt
programme.desc: Hunted. Persecuted. Executed. The witch trials come to life in modern day America. Claire (Gideon Adlon - The Craft: Legacy) and her mother (Elizabeth Mitchell - The Expanse) are part of an underground movement that ferries women accused of witchcraft to safety. All is well until a new charge brings the witch hunters to their door. Will they also be charged with the ungodly crime of being a witch?

programme.title: The Guardian
programme.desc: Little Miss Sunshine meets The Blind Side. Even losers can win! When an unlucky car salesman (Andy Garcia) finds himself thrown into caring for a homeless grifter (Dafne Keen) they embark on a cross country road trip to find her father. Loan sharks, side hustles and a lot of fun along the way, this car salesman soon discovers an old dog can learn new tricks.

programme.title: Colorado Christmas
programme.desc: Single mum Melody Miller has left her dream job of teaching music to work as a carer, so that she can better provide for her young daughter. When one of her clients falls ill, his son rushes home, who to Melody's surprise turns out to be none other than country music superstar, Johnny Colorado! As the unlikely pair grow closer, it looks like it could be the start of the perfect Christmas romance, until an old flame of Johnny's arrives at the family ranch....

programme.title: Christmas Couple's Retreat
programme.desc: Three couples attend a retreat to strengthen their respective relationships under the guidance of a famed therapist. But as the holiday season unfolds, unexpected challenges arise when the therapist must confront some feelings of her own, and sparks fly when one couple's son unexpectedly falls for the charming retreat manager. Will this festive getaway reignite these couples' love, or will it lead them down an entirely new path?

programme.title: On Angel Wings
programme.desc: One starry night, a shepherd boy is taken on a secret, magical night-flight to witness a Christmas miracle. Rachel is 8 and for the first time is allowed to join her brothers and sister to visit their grandfather, Amos, as he carries out his annual ritual of a night in the hills, where he worked as a young shepherd boy. Grandfather is delighted to see the children and a special bond is established between him and Rachel. He tells them how she reminds him of a magical night; he then proceeds to recount it. He explains how, ahead of the other shepherds protecting their flock with him, he is flown away by the Angel Gabriel, to be the first visitor to the newly born Christ child. This magical re-working of the nativity by the leading writer Michael Morpurgo (War Horse, Private Peaceful) is rich with human poignancy as we share this very special experience.

programme.title: 12 Days Of Giving
programme.desc: When Baxter Billings (David Blue - SGU Stargate Universe, Ugly Betty) wins a small fortune at his local shopping mall, he decides to become a Secret Santa to the people in his hometown. His anonymous philanthropy is contagious and soon enough the joy of giving at Christmas spreads across town. Along the way, Baxter forms a close friendship with Pamela (Ashley Jones - True Blood, The Bold and the Beautiful) and her young son Westin. He thinks he might be falling for Pamela... but there's one problem, he's already engaged! This Christmas, Baxter will have to choose between keeping promises or following his heart.

programme.title: Saving Santa
programme.desc: Once upon a time, Santa operated with just a small workshop and a few elves. But, as Christmas has grown ever bigger, Santa has been forced to innovate! Now his cleverest elves develop amazing technology, including a hologram to hide the North Pole and a time machine to allow Santa to deliver presents to every home in the world, in just the one night. Bernard is an elf who dreams of creating such inventions, but his job is to clean the reindeer stables! Yet when he creates an amazing Christmas memory machine, his luck might be changing. But Bernard's invention is broken by a curious elf, causing the North Pole's power to fail and the hologram hiding it to disappear. Now exposed to the outside world, it is spotted by Santa's enemy, Neville Baddington, who is determined to steal Santa's secrets for himself. The only person who can stop him is Bernard.

programme.title: The Magic Reindeer: The Flight Before Christmas
programme.desc: Niko the Reindeer enjoys his cool and carefree life in the Arctic, but that all changes when he is given his most surprising Christmas present ever - a little stepbrother named Jonni! Niko is unhappy about this new addition to the family, but when Jonni is kidnapped by eagles, Niko realises that it's down to him to fly off and rescue his brother!

programme.title: Twenty-One Days
programme.desc: Laurence Olivier and Vivien Leigh star in a tale of murder and unforeseen consequences.

programme.title: One Way Out
programme.desc: Harcourt is investigating the suicide of a woman who is found wearing a valuable necklace, recently stolen.

programme.title: Personal Affair
programme.desc: When a teenaged student disappears, her teacher is suspected of killing her.

programme.title: Portrait From Life
programme.desc: Major Lawrence wanders into an art gallery and is struck by the beauty of a young girl in a painting.

programme.title: Proud Valley
programme.desc: David Goliath, an unemployed stoker from a Cardiff, is making his way up the Welsh valleys in search of work.

programme.title: Four Christmases and a Wedding
programme.desc: Chloe (Arielle Kebbel) is hired to plan the local Christmas Festival.

programme.title: Last Chance for Christmas.
programme.desc: Santa's handsome but beleaguered stable master John must rush off to Alaska.

programme.title: A Snow Globe Christmas
programme.desc: TV exec rants about her imperfect Christmas movies, tries to smash snow globe.

programme.title: Last Chance for Christmas.
programme.desc: Santa's handsome but beleaguered stable master John must rush off to Alaska.

programme.desc: (1972) Western with James Coburn and Telly Savalas. Branded a coward for surrendering his fort to the Confederates, a Union colonel recruits seven condemned men for a daring mission to recapture it.

programme.title: Angel and the Badman
programme.desc: (1947) Western with the legendary John Wayne. A wounded gunslinger is taken in by a Quaker girl, who inspires him to give up his old ways - until his past catches up with him and puts her in danger.

programme.title: Air Rescue
programme.desc: A Gold Coast holidaymaker is caught in a deadly ocean rip current, a skydiver is airlifted to hospital, and a groom-to-be is left gripping to the side of a mountain with a suspected broken leg. S5Ep4

programme.title: Air Rescue
programme.desc: An injured man clings to the rocks after falling into the ocean, and a head-on car collision leaves two tourists fighting for their lives. S5Ep5

programme.title: Dispatch
programme.desc: (2016) Crime thriller with Fiona Gubelmann. A 911 operator takes a call from a child and dismisses it as a prank. But when a body is discovered, she'll do whatever it takes to make things right...

programme.title: Au Pair Nightmare
programme.desc: (2020) Twist-laden thriller with Annie Heise. To escape her past, Taylor becomes an au pair for a wealthy family. But scratching the surface of their perfect world will reveal some very dark secrets..

programme.title: Abducted: Fugitive For Love
programme.desc: (2007) Thriller starring Sarah Wynter. Sparks fly when a wrongly convicted prisoner is manipulated into kidnapping the prison warden's wife. Can they prove his innocence and find love on the run?

programme.title: An Aurora Teagarden Mystery: A Very Foul Play
programme.desc: (2019) Thriller with Candace Cameron Bure. Fiction becomes reality for super sleuth Aurora when she appears in a murder mystery play, only for the stage to become an actual crime scene...

programme.title: An Aurora Teagarden Mystery: The Disappearing Gam
programme.desc: (2018) Crime mystery starring Candace Cameron Bure and Lexa Doig. Crime-solving librarian Aurora is back on the case when students - including her cousin - vanish from a local college.

programme.title: Lost Letter Mysteries: From Paris With Love
programme.desc: (2015) Mystery drama with Eric Mabius and Kristin Booth. With lost divorce papers to deliver and Oliver's missing wife back in town, can the postal detectives unravel the mystery of true love?

programme.title: Lost Letter Mysteries: To The Altar
programme.desc: (2016) Mystery drama with Eric Mabius. Before Rita and Norman's wedding, the postal detectives work to reunite a mother and daughter, as well as delivering a lost wedding dress.

programme.title: Garage Sale Mysteries: The Beach Murders
programme.desc: (2017) Whodunnit with Lori Loughlin. When a customer believes her husband's surfing death wasn't an accident, antiques expert Jennifer must dig up some secrets and find a killer.

programme.title: Grounded for Christmas
programme.desc: (2019) Romance with Julianna Guill. After a stranded flight leaves them with no options, a pilot invites her charming rival to her parents' house, not realising she's booking a round trip to romance.

programme.title: Merry Mystery Christmas
programme.desc: (2023) Festive rom com with Brittany Bristow. Reporter Leslie teams up with local detective Preston to catch a Christmas display thief, but as they follow the clues will love be the real story?

programme.title: Meet Me at Christmas
programme.desc: (2020) Second-chance romance with Catherine Bell and Mark Deklin. Unexpectedly tasked with planning her son's wedding, Joan teams up with the bride's uncle. But are their fates already intertwined?

programme.title: A Very Country Christmas
programme.desc: (2017) Festive romance with Greyston Holt. A singer escapes the chaos of Hollywood to rediscover his love for country music. But what he stumbles upon is even better.

programme.title: It's Beginning to Look a Lot Like Christmas
programme.desc: (2019) Festive romance with Eric Mabius. When mayoral rivals Liam and Sarah enter a Christmas decorating contest, they end up with more than just Christmas spirit.

programme.title: A Family Matters Christmas
programme.desc: Christmas is anything but ordinary when three siblings from a newly blended household cannot see eye to eye. With the help of some magic, they switch bodies and cannot change back until they learn to spend the holidays as a loving family.

programme.title: A Perfect Christmas List
programme.desc: As a last wish, a recently hospitalized grandmother tasks her daughter Michelle and granddaughter Sara with a list of festive accomplishments to do together before Christmas, hoping that the adventure of the experience will repair their relationship.

programme.title: Beaus Of Holly
programme.desc: When Holly proposes to Phil, he admits he needs closure with an ex. Heartbroken, she confides in sleigh driver Jake, who offers unexpected comfort. Is Phil her true love, or is Jake the Christmas miracle she’s been waiting for?

programme.title: A Christmas Wedding Tail
programme.desc: A newlywed couples warring kids from past families look set to cause irreparable problems, until their loved-up pet pooches get involved.

programme.title: Christmas in Big Sky Country
programme.desc: Becca teams up with the oil company’s new PR rep, Logan Johnston, to get her brother-in-law safely home for the holidays.

programme.title: A Frozen Christmas
programme.desc: Festive animation filled with popular Christmas characters including Santa Claus, The Snowman, Elves and Santa's Reindeer. programme.desc: On today’s episode of The Therapy Crouch, Abbey and Peter are joined by some of their oldest and closest friends - Steve and Krysy Sidwell. In a friendship spanning two decades which has seen the couples share career paths, holidays and some outrageous nights out, this podcast is full of laughs and a behind the curtain, sneak peak into what it’s like being best friends with your favourite pair of podcasters! Steve and Krysy discuss what they think has made their 20 year marriage stay rock solid after all these years and how they are navigating having three teenage boys who have developed of penchant for knocking seven bells of sh*t out of each other on a regular basis. In the Agony Ab section, we hear from a listener who has some concerns about his wife’s recent fashion choices as well what to do in the awkward situation when someone likes you more than you like them - so stay tuned for that!! Enjoy this week’s Therapy Crouch!

We learn why you can't trust Abbey to keep a clean car and how Peter is considering taking up a career modelling fake tan. And, as always, Agony Ab is on hand to give you the listener some advice for your tricky relationship problems. Enjoy!

programme.title: They Call Me The Godfather
programme.desc: Welcome back to The Therapy Crouch! On this week’s episode Abbey and Peter are on hand to share some pearls of wisdom on what makes a good godparent, and some top tips on how to expertly navigate a thanks but no thanks conversation with your nearest and dearest. In Agony Ab, Abbey and Peter are on hand to help when your better half suddenly decides to take up the gym 10 years too late and we hear from Louis, one of our international listeners who needs some advice on how to make the first move! We hope you enjoy this very special episode from the OG Podfather and your fairy Podmother!

programme.title: Joe Lycett On Fatherhood, Burnout, & Finding Yourself Again
programme.desc: Comedian Joe Lycett discusses identity, fatherhood and burnout with Fearne Cotton. Joe reflects on how much of his stage persona has become who he actually is, why paternity leave triggered existential crises, and how he's come out the other side caring less about what anyone thinks. They also explore losing inhibitions in the age of camera phones, why playing around and making mistakes matters as an adult, and how Ant and Dec have accidentally changed Joe's behaviour at hotels.

programme.title: Nicole LePera On How To Re-parent Yourself
programme.desc: Psychologist Dr Nicole LePera discusses how childhood praise and well-intentioned parenting can leave us with patterns that run our adult lives on autopilot. She explains how to reparent your inner child, starting with finding a childhood photograph, and shares ways to tune in with your body throughout the day to release stress.

programme.title: Alan Cumming: “My Dad Told Me I Was Worthless”
programme.desc: Alan Cumming's dad told him he was worthless, and his mum told him he was precious. Figuring out how he feels about himself has been a life's work. In this chat with Fearne, Alan's open about the ways he's allowed people to treat him badly, and how he's learnt to get comfortable with confrontation and setting boundaries. He also explains why the rage in the script of his new TV show triggered painful childhood memories.

programme.title: Emma Grede On Why You Can’t Be A People Pleaser And A Leader
programme.desc: Entrepreneur Emma Grede, co-founder of Good American, discusses why women need to talk openly about money and know their worth. She explains why ambition isn't a dirty word, why you can't be a people pleaser and a leader, and why getting comfortable with failure and self-doubt is essential. As a mother of four, Emma shares her thoughts on mum guilt and why it's important that children see their mothers chasing their goals.

programme.title: Lucas Jones Explores What We're All Searching For In Life
programme.desc: Poet and actor Lucas Jones joins Fearne Cotton to explore what we're all searching for in life—whether we call it God, the Universe, spirituality, or science. They bond over their inability to do small talk, preferring deeper conversations about big feelings, and both share their experiences of living with OCD. Lucas discusses how therapy, particularly CBT, has helped him, but questions whether the rise in therapy reflects a loss of real community.

programme.title: Bryony Gordon On How People Pleasing Fuelled My OCD
programme.desc: Author and mental health advocate Bryony Gordon explores how people pleasing has fuelled parts of her OCD, alcoholism, and eating disorders over the years. Fearne and Bryony discuss the 'fawn' trauma response - appeasing others to stay safe - and chat about body image and the insecurities that have consumed them. Bryony reckons feeling 'too much' and 'not enough' are two sides of the same coin, and offers advice on how to confidently take up space.

programme.title: Boy George on AI, Spirituality & Why Jealousy Is Pointless
programme.desc: Boy George joins Fearne to discuss ego, jealousy, fame, grief and the mindset shift that changed everything. From embracing the Three Principles to tapping every morning, he explains how learning to pause before reacting helped him let go of resentment and feel lighter than ever. He opens up about loving fame and why he'd do it differently if he could start again, AI, and why "hating someone is completely pointless".

programme.title: How Oligarchs Control Democracy
programme.desc: Jeffrey Winters, a political scientist at Northwestern University, explores how oligarchs turn wealth into political power. Winters challenges conventional thinking about power, arguing that oligarchs aren't just corrupt billionaires in distant countries but individuals whose vast wealth gives them influence far beyond ordinary citizens. They operate within democratic systems, not outside them.

programme.title: How America's Military Was Taken Over By White Supremacists
programme.desc: Matt Kennard discusses his book Irregular Army: How the US Military Recruited Neo-Nazis, Gang Members and Criminals. Kennard details how, as the wars in Iraq and Afghanistan dragged on, the Bush administration faced a recruitment crisis. Rather than reintroducing the draft, it loosened enlistment standards, opening the door to recruits who would previously have been barred from service.

programme.title: How AI Will Destroy Democracy - Daron Acemoglu Interview
programme.desc: Daron Acemoglu, a Nobel Prize-winning economist and author of What Happened to Liberal Democracy, discusses why liberal democracy is facing one of its biggest crises in generations. Acemoglu argues that the problems facing democracies go much deeper than individual politicians. Across the UK, US and Europe, trust in political institutions has eroded as economic growth has become less widely shared, communities have weakened and the relationship between political elites and working-class voters has fractured.

programme.title: Holocaust Survivor Eviscerates The Far-Right - Stephen Kapos Interview
programme.desc: Stephen Kapos is an 88-year-old Holocaust survivor who discusses his activism, his opposition to Israel's systemic destruction of Gaza and the West Bank, and how the memory of the Holocaust is being abused by Israel and the far-right.

programme.title: Ed Sheeran's Palestine Downfall
programme.desc: Ed Sheeran dropped Macklemore from his tour over the artist's pro-Palestine platform. He played his last gig alone, after all of his supporting artists and his backing band dropped out in solidarity. Ava and Seán break down what happened and react to Sheeran's apology.

programme.title: Did A GB News Host Write A Book Full Of AI Slop?
programme.desc: Andy investigates Matthew Goodwin's new book and uncovers significant issues with its content. After Goodwin's defeat in the Gorton and Denton by-election, his release is examined closely, with Andy and Ava challenging a series of claims that don't hold up. From questionable statistics about English language use in schools to references that appear to trace back to ChatGPT, the pair expose what is at the very least a lack of academic rigour.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: Alice Ruggles was 24 years old, full of life, and doing everything right. She had a great job, an amazing group of friends, and her whole future ahead of her. But after ending a relationship with army soldier Trimaan "Harry" Dhillon, Alice found herself trapped in a nightmare she couldn't escape. Dhillon refused to accept the breakup and launched a relentless stalking campaign , showing up uninvited, flooding her with messages, and watching her every move. Alice did what she was supposed to do. She told people. She went to the police. And the system still failed her. In October 2016, Dhillon broke into Alice's flat in Gateshead and murdered her. He was later convicted and sentenced to life in prison with a minimum of 22 years. But for Alice's family, no sentence could undo what happened. What makes this case so important is everything that led up to it, the warning signs that were there from the start, and the gaps in the system that allowed a known stalker to get close enough to kill. Alice's family has since founded the Alice Ruggles Trust, working to raise awareness about the dangers of stalking and push for stronger protections for victims. This is a solved true crime case that everyone needs to know about. Alice's story is a reminder of how deadly stalking can be when it's not taken seriously.

programme.title: Gronland - In the Glare of Ice
programme.desc: Greenland is the largest island in the world and the landmass closest to the North Pole. 80% of the country is covered by a layer of ice up to 3000 meters thick. Most of the inhabitants of the country are spread over the breathtaking landscape of the ice-free west coast. The country is mostly inhabited by Inuit, who have been feeding on what nature has provided them for thousands of years. But the original life is in a state of change. The modernisation of society and man-made global warming threaten the Arctic natural paradise that is so incredibly important for our planet. Through the eyes of locals we get to know the authentic Greenland.

programme.title: Iceland - On Top of the World
programme.desc: A scenic expedition through majestic volcanoes, seething geysers, powerful waterfalls, threatening fjords and almighty glaciers. Hardly any other country offers such a variety of spectacular forces of nature! We will give you an insight on how it can be that the people of a small, distant island with only a fraction of sunlight in some months are happier than the people in more sun-blessed countries.

programme.title: mareTV: Sweden's High Coast
programme.desc: Sweden's Höga Kusten (High Coast) has been rising by almost one centimetre per year since the last ice age 10,000 years ago. This has created a hilly Baltic Sea landscape on the Gulf of Bothnia with small and large islands. Untouched nature, dense forests and energetic, rather idiosyncratic islanders have plenty of room there. Every year at the end of August a biting stench mixes with the fresh Baltic Sea breeze. For weeks the so-called sour herring, Swedish: Surströmming, is fermented in brine. Ruben Madsen is a producer of surströmming and an absolute connoisseur. In his wooden hut on the island of Ulvön he puts the herring in according to a traditional recipe. At the start of the season, the cans are opened for the first time. Lovers of the "stinky fish" then come from all over the world to taste the now world-famous delicacy in cans. Opening the cans of "rotten fish" is considered internationally as a test of courage, people film themselves doing so, the inhabitants of the High Coast can only smile about it.

programme.title: Wild Skagerrak
programme.desc: The strait that connects the North Sea with the Baltic, with depths of over 700 metres, is notorious for its dangerously strong currents. But currents also mean food and therefore nourishment for the large swarms of fish that inhabit the region. The sea grass meadows are comparable with those off the Californian coast. Harbour seals, grey seals and orcas hunt here, as do the rare black mouth cat shark and porpoises. Close by, catfish mate, which in itself is quite spectacular and never caught on film in this way before. Lion's mane jellyfish with nettle threads of up to 30 metres in length make their way through the open sea. Skagerrak's coastal regions are amongst the most beautiful and varied in Europe and boast one of the world's great bird paradises. Oystercatchers, sandwich and arctic terns are more plentiful here than anywhere else in Europe. The infinitely long dune landscape of the Skagerrak, is Denmark's answer to the skerries of the Swedish and Norwegian coasts. Large seal colonies can be found in the isolation of the small, picturesque islands and one can come face to face with the animals. In this rough, yet infinitely beautiful landscape, the many streams and rivers that open out into the Skagerrak, are quite remarkable. We accompany salmon in an equally beautiful river landscape and meet with ospreys and sea eagles and eventually come face to face with a brown bear mother and her little ones.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.desc: Winter means more than just the beginning of the year for the people of Lofoten: For more than a thousand years, Lofoten has been a hub for cod fishing, with seasons lasting from February to April as huge shoals migrate from the Barents Sea to these waters. During these hectic months, more than 65,000 tons of fish are brought to shore, securing the income for the whole of Lofoten for years to come. Around a quarter of the fish caught ends up on lines to dry upon racks. From a young age, the children from the fishing villages get to earn some pocket money by cutting cod tongues and selling the produce as a delicacy appreciated by the locals.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.desc: Almost unnoticeably, spring turns into summer. The days become longer and longer, with a never-setting sun. People who have spent their winter and spring working hard can finally enjoy their own nature, even though the temperature is only slightly warmer. Lofoten is sparsely populated, just 24,000 people live here. Unstad is one of its smallest communities with only 15 inhabitants, but despite that, it has become a hotspot for arctic surf and is host to the northern-most surf center in the world. Surfers from all over the globe come to surf in the arctic water.

programme.title: Europe's far North - Lofoten and the Arctic Ocean
programme.desc: Lofoten is the rugged archipelago in the Norwegian Arctic Ocean. Whoever arrives here is really at the end. Moskenes is the end of the line, and anyone who wants to go further needs a boat or a plane. The only way to get to the open sea is via the Maelstrom, which is quite dangerous. On the outermost headland, there are only a few ruins left. The last inhabitants are long gone, a supply was hardly possible. But fishermen are on the way, mainly to catch cod. And there is the coastal administration, which takes care of broken sea marks and lighthouses. A visit to one of the luxurious ships of the Hurtig Line is not to be missed. They shuttle off rough coasts on an eleven-day trip between the Russian border and southern Norway. A floating workplace for a wide variety of professions. The island of Andøya is not served by the Hurtiglinie. It lies too far out in the Atlantic. One of the most important observatories in Europe is located here. A young woman, Sandra Blindheim, is the boss. She is responsible for the large laser that delivers important information to scientists around the world. On clear winter nights, there is a wonderful panoramic view of the aurora borealis.

programme.title: GTA 5's Franklin Reacts To Grand Theft Auto V
programme.desc: Shawn Solo Fonteno, aka Franklin from Grand Theft Auto 5, joins us to break down viral scenes from the game as well as GTA Online's The Contract missions. 00:00 Introduction 00:15 Franklin talks to a dog mission 02:22 Franklin gets roasted by Lamar 05:20 Trevor falls over 09:08 Franklin in GTA Online's The Contract 12:58 Chop 13:58 Choosing ending C 18:28 Outro It's hard to believe it's been almost a decade since GTA 5 launched, partly because it is still getting updated and brought to current-gen consoles, and partly because its multiplayer counterpart, GTA Online, is still getting meaningful updates. Take its most recent update, The Contract, for example, not only did it pull in heavyweights Dr Dre and DJ Pooh, but also brought back GTA 5 protagonist Franklin. To celebrate, we brought in Franklin's actor, Shawn 'Solo' Fonteno, to discuss what it was like making GTA 5, and to react to some of the game's most popular clips. In the above video, he describes what it was like to work with both the real and fake Chop the dog, his experience learning Franklin's role in the story, as well as the origins of the infamous Franklin gets roasted clip. programme.title: I'M LIVE - Kwon Jin ah episode 237
programme.desc: I'm LIVE presents three special episodes in commemoration of the end of the year and having a live audience for the first time in 2 years! The trilogy is composed of the Christmas Special the Year-End Special and the New-Year Special and the guest of the Year-End Special Episode is Kwon Jin ah. Kwon Jin ah is known for her tranquil and heartwarming voice that genuinely comforts our hearts. In February this year she released her first self-produced EP “The Way For Us” and showed off her capabilities as a songwriter and producer as well. In this episode Kwon Jin ah performs “KNOCK” “This Winter” and her solo version of “Hello Antenna Hello Christmas” the carol jointly released by musicians on the record label Antenna. Also famous for her live singing skills and ticket-selling power this artist is bound to melt our souls during this cold winter season. I'm LIVE allows musicians and fans to interact up-close within a distance of 1 meter. Numerous big names and rookies in the Korean music scene including Jannabi 10CM HYUKOH SE SO NEON CNBLUE Jeongmilla BIBI NIve and Lydia Lee have participated in the show. Also only those who have been fully vaccinated (defined as more than 14 days after the final vaccine dose) can participate in the live recording as an audience.

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Juk Jae episode 238
programme.desc: I'm LIVE presents three special episodes in commemoration of the end of the year and having a live audience for the first time in 2 years! The trilogy is composed of the Christmas Special the Year-End Special and the New-Year Special and the guest of the New-Year Special Episode is Juk Jae. Juk Jae is a guitarist-turned-singer-songwriter known for his lyrical and ambient songs with a guitar sound. Since his debut in 2014 he has collaborated with numerous singers including IU and Zion T and has also released many hit songs but he is still determined to show his transformation and growth through music. As part of that effort he hosts the audio show “Juk Jae's Night Time Studio” and also went on his first concert tour across Korea in November last year. In this New-Year Special Edition Juk Jae performs “Let’s Go See The Stars” “Sky Dream” “One Another” and more to amaze our ears and souls. I'm LIVE allows musicians and fans to interact up-close within a distance of 1 meter. Numerous big names and rookies in the Korean music scene including Jannabi 10CM HYUKOH SE SO NEON CNBLUE Jeongmilla BIBI NIve and Lydia Lee have participated in the show. Also only those who have been fully vaccinated (defined as more than 14 days after the final vaccine dose) can participate in the live recording as an audience.

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Younha episode 239
programme.desc: Joining us on this week’s I’m LIVE is singer-songwriter Younha! Younha began her career in 2003 in Japan with her first single “ゆびきり.” Then she found mainstream success the following year with her second Japanese single “ほうき星 (Comet)” which was included on the soundtrack of the anime series “Bleach.” The song peaked on the Oricon Chart at #15 giving her the nickname of the “Oricon Comet.” Her success in the island country led to her debut in Korea as well; she debuted in Korea in 2016 where she is regarded as one of the country’s best singer-songwriters. From “Waiting” to “Password 486” Younha has many hit songs under her belt. She has also collaborated with numerous A-list musicians including Toy and Epik High. In November last year Younha released her sixth full-length album “END THEORY” to once again prove how versatile of a musician she is. From rock to ballad music she covered various genres in the album and the album’s lead single “Stardust” was chosen as one of Billboard’s Best K-pop Songs of the Year. In this episode Younha performs “Stardust” “Wish” “Waiting” “How U doing” and more to nourish our hearts. Tune in to I’m LIVE and meet this talented artist!

programme.title: The Light and Shade of Fashion
programme.desc: The big names in fashion choose Ticino. They come here in ever greater numbers and have a significant impact on the local economy. Our investigation into Europe and Ticino's Fashion Valley reveals that behind the scenes they use every trick in the book to boost profits, from tax loopholes to a system of subcontracting that delegates production to Chinese Italians working in unacceptable conditions. A disillusioned look at the big brands.

programme.title: Unwelcome Tourism
programme.desc: Unwelcome Tourism - Tourism drives up prices and brutalizes stores, restaurants and culture in general. In the most visited cities in Europe, there are neighborhoods from which residents are being forced out - tourists can pay rents that locals cannot afford. This is especially true in Venice and Barcelona, where people are mobilizing to demand that tourism be kept within certain limits.

programme.title: The Street Food Hype
programme.desc: Gourmet sandwiches, salads, cakes and also ethnic cuisine, fried fish, ribs or spleen: these are just some of the recipes offered by the army of four-wheeled chefs that fill the streets.

programme.title: Corruption in Africa
programme.desc: A magnificent villa overlooking the Gulf of Lugano. Luxury cars parked in several garages. Plus gardeners, waiters and bodyguards. Kola Aluko, the Nigerian who was targeted by Nigerian and British justice for allegedly raking in billions of dollars that did not belong to him. Money that came from Nigerian oil wells, money that was taken from government accounts.

programme.title: Food Obsession
programme.desc: Some people eat only fruit, some only meat, some only raw foods, some only at certain times of the day. More and more people are obsessed with what they eat, and in some cases this is developing into a full-blown disease.

programme.title: Soccer Talents
programme.desc: The "Messis" and "Ronaldos" of the future are growing up in Lugano. Leonid Novoselsky is convinced of that. The Russian businessman is investing a lot of energy and large sums of money to transform Switzerland into the best football school in the world.

programme.title: Vatican Connection
programme.desc: It is the biggest financial scandal of the last 30 years. Not only because of its economic magnitude, but also because this time Pope Francis has decided to instruct the Vatican judiciary to proceed without leniency.

programme.title: Mafia, Cocaine and White Collar Workers
programme.desc: There is the cocaine, tons of cocaine, one of the richest and most important Ndrangheta bosses in Europe and the so-called Swiss washing machine. This report traces the flow of dirty money from dealers in South America and offers a disconcerting window into the lives of Ticino’s “white collar workers”
